TWO TARGETS ARE MEASURED BUT NOT JOINED, and this is the whole
adjudication for this surface. Three boards draw this same header and
strip and they do not agree:
header background   32:3 and 642:3251 draw NO fill (the panel shows

Both are one chrome element, not a per-profile one -- an inspector whose
header changed colour depending on what you selected would be a defect,
not conformance. Joining them here would encode the minority reading and
make inspector-profile-container-fallback fail instead. Recorded rather
than silently dropped; if the MEDIA board is the intended direction, all
three boards move together and both joins come back.
